classified.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

template.name: Permanent Castable for {C}
template.scryfallQuery: mv<=1 (mana={0} or mana={1} or mana={C}) is:permanent

classified.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

classified.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each card in your library.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting that many growth counters on itself.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: Your library size is at least twenty.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
You have a way to draw a card.

classified.description:
Pay {U}{G} and tap Vorel to double the number of counters on Magistrate's Scepter, leaving it with 6 counters.
Tap Magistrate's Scepter to gain an extra turn.
Move to that extra turn.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
3 charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.

classified.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep
Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control

classified.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
"Tentacle" chosen with Kindred Discovery.

classified.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.easy_prerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.

classified.description:
Cast Conclave Sledge-Captain by paying {5}{G}.
When Conclave Sledge-Captain enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers three times.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature with power 3 or greater, and causing it to gain the printed abilities until end of turn.
Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers, putting a growth counter on it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Deal combat damage with the creature that was targeted in step 3, triggering the creature's ability three times.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the creature equal to the damage dealt.
Simic Ascendancy's first ability triggers, putting that many growth counters on it.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked an opponent.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Activate Merfolk Skydiver, proliferating the charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat step one an additional two times.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has a least one charge counter on it.

classified.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a copy of Palinchron.
The copy of Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
The nontoken Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
outcomes: Infinite mana lands you control can produce

classified.description:
Activate Colossus of Akros by paying {10}, putting twenty +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to become monstrous.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting twenty growth counters on itself.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites: Colossus of Akros is not monstrous.
outcomes: Win the game at the beginning of your next upkeep

classified.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
classified.notable_prerequisites: Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.

classified.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat from step 2.

During your cleanup step, discard down to your maximum hand size.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each card discarded this way.
When the Zombie(s) enter the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers that many times, causing you to draw that many cards.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat from step 2.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.

classified.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
Note that this will cause you to lose due to drawing from an empty library unless you can remove a combo piece or win the game.
classified.notable_prerequisites:
"Insect" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
You have a way to draw a card.

classified.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Bladewing.
The Bladewing copy enters the battlefield, choose not to return a Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the original Bladewing.
Put the nontoken Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter the battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
classified.notable_prerequisites: "Zombie" or "Dragon" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.

classified.description:
Cast Sharuum.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Sharrum.
Sharuum dies to state based actions.
Sharuum's enter the battlefield trigger is put on the stack, targeting Sharuum in your graveyard.
Repeat steps 3-4.

Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Kiora's Follower with haste.
Tap the Kiora's Follower token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.
outcomes: Infinite tapped creature tokens with haste

classified.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: You must have a way to stop this combo, otherwise you will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
classified.notable_prerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
